about: Third catalog for tests/compat/run.sh (--catalog), chosen by demand: apps people ask for on Linux, from request threads, forum lists, AlternativeTo and GitHub stars, most of them with no Flathub listing. Some apps come in more than one format (.deb and .rpm, or an AppImage as well), so the 793 entries cover 652 apps. The fields are the same as in apps2.json.
